description: This file is a controller class within an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It manages sale orders in the admin interface, providing functionalities such as listing, viewing details, creating invoices, shipping info, order history, and modifying order data like rewards, commissions, and status updates.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing admin sale orders in OpenCart, providing CRUD operations, invoice generation, shipping details, order history, reward and commission adjustments, and API calls.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of orders with filter options and action buttons.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the order list view, typically called via AJAX.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and compiles the list of orders based on filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific order, including customer info, products, totals, and status.

methods.name: call
methods.description: APICall to the storefront API, facilitating external interactions with order data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected orders from the database.

methods.name: invoice
methods.description: Generates and displays an invoice for selected orders.

methods.name: shipping
methods.description: Prepares and shows shipping details for selected orders.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Returns the order history for an order.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves paginated history entries for an order.

methods.name: createInvoiceNo
methods.description: Creates a new invoice number for an order if it doesn't already have one.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Adds reward points to a customer based on an order.

methods.name: removeReward
methods.description: Removes reward points assigned to an order.

methods.name: addCommission
methods.description: Adds a commission transaction for an affiliate linked to an order.

methods.name: removeCommission
methods.description: Removes any commission transaction linked to an order.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete data for order search fields.
